answer.says: You are right, Shri Hegde. The procedure is its own end, and I should not ask the instrument to explain the mechanism. I will go to the table.
answer.thought: He pats my shoulder with the firmness of a man who has survived thirty years in the secretariat and knows that the file does not care for the soul. The raita is a small, concrete good in a night of abstract friction. I will eat it before the night dissolves into further speculation.
